gate: Hash frozen before the holdout. Official engine, paired against the strongest unmodified public agent of the wave (gluzdov_omw) on identical opponents/seeds/seats. Gate: total paired score >= +10, mirror against the control >= 50%, no opponent with a paired delta below -2.0 (one world, both seats), no reported errors/fallbacks, every callback < 1000 ms. The Kaggle kernel then repeats the gate on four fresh seeds against three Metav4-family opponents (the verification notebook must stay under 1 MB, so all embedded agents share one sale library). Registered before the run.
attribution: Base: Dmitrii Gluzdov, One More Wheat (a derivative of Thomas Tschinkel, The Metav4 Farm v13, Apache-2.0, with the upstream authors credited in its source). Lab layer: lockstep sale ordering against a copy (frontier5_lockstep.py), unchanged. The pre-emption patch of Frontier9 was measured on this base and is not part of the candidate.
limitations: Local panels are small and dominated by public tape lineages; no rating or medal guarantee.
